SELECT join_date, COUNT(*) AS version_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members, COUNT(DISTINCT member_key) AS distinct_keys, MIN(valid_from) AS min_vf, MAX(valid_from) AS max_vf
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-08'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH firsts AS (
  SELECT member_id, MIN(valid_from) AS first_vf, MIN(join_date) AS min_jd, MAX(join_date) AS max_jd, COUNT(*) AS versions
  FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN min_jd = DATE '2026-10-03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_join_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN first_vf = DATE '2026-10-03' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS by_first_valid_from,
  SUM(CASE WHEN min_jd <> max_jd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS members_with_varying_join_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN min_jd = DATE '2026-10-03' AND first_vf <> min_jd THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatch,
  SUM(CASE WHEN min_jd = DATE '2026-10-03' AND versions > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_version
FROM firsts
